_meta.description: Agent roster for the S/4HANA Public Cloud pipeline. Each agent is a role (also defined as a Claude Code subagent in .claude/agents/) orchestrated by the Delivery Lead across the pipeline, running its mapped skill. No per-agent API keys — Claude Code is the shared runtime.
_meta.runtime: Claude (session model) — no per-agent API keys
_meta.orchestration: Delivery Lead + 5 specialist roles across the 12-step pipeline. Automated (headless) runs execute inline for speed; the .claude/agents/ subagents can be delegated via the Task tool in an interactive session.

agents.name: Delivery Lead
agents.role: Orchestrates the pipeline: delegates each step to the right specialist, owns the 3 quality gates and 3 human checkpoints, and packages the final deliverables.

agents.name: Extensibility Architect
agents.role: Analyses the FD (fit-to-standard, requirement quality) and decides the extensibility mode per capability (key user / developer / side-by-side); owns the release-verdict gate.

agents.name: Developer
agents.role: Builds per the chosen mode: RAP/CDS/released BAdIs + Fiori Elements (developer); Custom Fields & Logic, Adapt UI, CDS views, analytical queries, forms, flexible workflow (key user); or CAP/ABAP Environment + Integration Suite iFlows (side-by-side).

agents.name: Clean-Core Reviewer
agents.role: Adversarial review + security: lint gate, release-verdict gate, upgrade-safety challenge, plus authorization concept, secret hygiene and input validation.

agents.name: Test Agent
agents.role: ABAP Unit design with test doubles; API test scripts; negative tests mapped to acceptance criteria.

agents.name: Challenger
agents.role: Final challenge round before ship — tries to break the design and confirm the extensibility-pattern selection.
